# intrinsics.library: NumberToShortestString

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> The shortest text that reads back to this exact Number through NumberFromText, bit
> for bit (the shortest round-trip digits, in the invariant culture): "0.1", "100",
> "1E+17", "1E-05", "-0" (plain digits from 1E-04 up to below 1E+17, scientific
> outside, as .NET writes the "R" form). NaN, Infinity and -Infinity are written "NaN", "Infinity" and
> "-Infinity", and IsNumberText rejects all three, so only finite Numbers round-trip.
> Not expressible in Plato: shortest round-trip digit generation needs the host's
> algorithm (Ryu or Grisu with a fallback) and every runtime must pick the same digits.
> Witness: NumberToShortestString(0.5) == "0.5" and NumberToShortestString(1e-5) == "1E-05".

## Signature

```plato
NumberToShortestString(x: Number): String
```

## Laws

These are declared laws. Whether each one passes is recorded by the law runner ([stdlib/VERIFICATION.md](../../../../../stdlib/VERIFICATION.md)), not by this page.

### Law_ParseNumberRoundTripsNumberToShortestString

[stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato, line 130](../../../../../stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato#L130)

```plato
// The round trip: reading the shortest text of a finite Number gives back that Number
// exactly, sign of zero included (1 / x tells 0 from -0). The runner draws Numbers from
// [-10, 10] and a few special values.
Law_ParseNumberRoundTripsNumberToShortestString(x: Number): Boolean
    => ParseNumber(NumberToShortestString(x)).Ok
    && ParseNumber(NumberToShortestString(x)).Value == x
    && 1.0 / ParseNumber(NumberToShortestString(x)).Value == 1.0 / x;
```

### Law_NumberToShortestStringWitness

[stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato, line 146](../../../../../stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato#L146)

```plato
// Two-line witness: the layout of the text, and that the non-finite values are not numbers.
Law_NumberToShortestStringWitness(): Boolean
    => NumberToShortestString(0.5) == "0.5" && NumberToShortestString(100.0) == "100" && NumberToShortestString(1e16) == "10000000000000000"
    && NumberToShortestString(1e17) == "1E+17" && NumberToShortestString(1e-5) == "1E-05" && NumberToShortestString(-1.5) == "-1.5" && NumberToShortestString(0.1) == "0.1";
```

### Law_NonFiniteNumbersHaveTextThatIsNotANumber

[stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato, line 150](../../../../../stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato#L150)

```plato
Law_NonFiniteNumbersHaveTextThatIsNotANumber(): Boolean
    => NumberToShortestString(0.0 / 0.0) == "NaN" && NumberToShortestString(1.0 / 0.0) == "Infinity"
    && NumberToShortestString(-1.0 / 0.0) == "-Infinity"
    && !ParseNumber("NaN").Ok && !ParseNumber("Infinity").Ok && !ParseNumber("-Infinity").Ok;
```
